Name: The Weaver’s Arms. Style: Cask ales, pub classics and Sunday roasts. Town: Nottingham, 9 Lace Row (example), Nottingham NG1.
Hours: Sunday: 12 noon till 10:30pm. Monday to Thursday: 12 noon till 11pm. Friday and Saturday: 12 noon till midnight. Food from 12 noon until 9pm; Sunday roasts until 6pm. Drinks until close.
Rooms: The bar, Dining room, Beer garden, The Loft. Children: Children are welcome with an adult until 9pm: there’s a children’s menu and colouring. Dogs: welcome everywhere.

Menu: Soup of the day with bread, Whitebait with tartare sauce, Garlic mushrooms on toast, Beer-battered fish and chips, Weaver's burger, Pie of the day, Sausage and mash, Wild mushroom risotto, Chickpea and spinach curry, Roast beef, Roast pork, Nut roast, Children's roast, Fish fingers and chips, Sausage and mash, Pasta in tomato sauce, Sticky toffee pudding, Apple crumble and custard, Chocolate brownie with ice cream, Lemon sorbet.
On tap: Lace Market Bitter (example), Trent Pale (example), Weaver’s Gold (example), Castle Rock Stout (example).

ID: We run Challenge 25: anyone who looks under 25 is asked for ID. A passport, a photo driving licence, a PASS card or a certified digital ID app. Smoking: Smoking in the beer garden only. Access: Step-free into the bar and the dining room, with an accessible toilet. The Loft is up a flight of stairs. Parking: No parking of our own; the nearest car park is about five minutes’ walk.

Cash: yes. Tips are never expected; any paid by card go to the team in full. Hire: The Loft upstairs takes up to 40, for parties, wakes and work dos: the manager will call back to talk it through. Christmas: Our Christmas menu is served from late November: the manager will call back to arrange a party. Jobs: We’re often looking for bar and kitchen staff: leave your name and number and the manager will be in touch.
